description: GeoMx ROI and Segment Metadata Attributes. The assayed biospecimen should be reported one per row with the associated ROI and AOI coordinates.

BiospecimenKey.description: Unique Biospecimen_id foreign key(s) that link metadata entries as part of the same collection. Please provide multiple values as a comma-separated list.
BiospecimenKey.title: Biospecimen Key

GeoMxAOIName.description: Name of Area of Illumination corresponding to file. Multiple names should be comma-separated
GeoMxAOIName.title: GeoMx AOI Name

GeoMxAOIXCoordinate.description: Area of Illumination X location within the image
GeoMxAOIXCoordinate.title: GeoMx AOI X Coordinate

GeoMxAOIYCoordinate.description: Area of Illumination Y location within the image
GeoMxAOIYCoordinate.title: GeoMx AOI Y Coordinate

GeoMxBindingDensity.description: The binding density as reported by the application
GeoMxBindingDensity.title: GeoMx Binding Density

GeoMxExcludedOutlierProbes.description: The list of probes excluded from analysis.
GeoMxExcludedOutlierProbes.title: GeoMx Excluded Outlier Probes

GeoMxLimitofQuantification.description: The calculated limit of quantification associated with the segment.
GeoMxLimitofQuantification.title: GeoMx Limit of Quantification

GeoMxNegativecountmean.description: The geometric mean of the unique negative probes in a GeoMx panel that do not target mRNA and establish the background count level per segment
GeoMxNegativecountmean.title: GeoMx Negative count mean

GeoMxNoTemplateControlcount.description: The number of reads detected by the GeoMx probe panel in the control associated with this ROI.
GeoMxNoTemplateControlcount.title: GeoMx No Template Control count

GeoMxNucleicount.description: Number of nuclei detected in the segment (if applicable)
GeoMxNucleicount.title: GeoMx Nuclei count

GeoMxPositivenormfactor.description: The Positive Control Normalization factor calculated using pos-hyb controls
GeoMxPositivenormfactor.title: GeoMx Positive norm factor

GeoMxQCstatus.description: ROI quality control flag as reported by the application
GeoMxQCstatus.title: GeoMx QC status

GeoMxROIName.description: Name of Region of Interest corresponding to file. Multiple names should be comma-separated
GeoMxROIName.title: GeoMx ROI Name

GeoMxROIXCoordinate.description: Region of Interest X location within the image
GeoMxROIXCoordinate.title: GeoMx ROI X Coordinate

GeoMxROIYCoordinate.description: Region of Interest Y location within the image
GeoMxROIYCoordinate.title: GeoMx ROI Y Coordinate

GeoMxScanHeight.description: Height of the scan for GeoMx Analysis
GeoMxScanHeight.title: GeoMx Scan Height

GeoMxScanOffsetX.description: Offset X of the scan for GeoMx Analysis
GeoMxScanOffsetX.title: GeoMx Scan Offset X

GeoMxScanOffsetY.description: Offset Y of the scan for GeoMx Analysis
GeoMxScanOffsetY.title: GeoMx Scan Offset Y

GeoMxScanWidth.description: Width of the scan for GeoMx Analysis
GeoMxScanWidth.title: GeoMx Scan Width

GeoMxScanname.description: GeoMx Scan name (as appears in Segment Summary)
GeoMxScanname.title: GeoMx Scan name

GeoMxSlidename.description: Similar to a Run ID, the slide name indicates the slide a given ROI is linked to (as reported in Segment Summary).
GeoMxSlidename.title: GeoMx Slide name

GeoMxSurfacearea.description: Surface area of the ROI in square microns (µm2)
GeoMxSurfacearea.title: GeoMx Surface area

GeoMxTags.description: The basename(s) or unique identifier(s) for FASTQ, RCC, or DCC file(s) associated with this ROI.
GeoMxTags.title: GeoMx Tags

GeoMxTissueStain.description: Text description of the stain, fluorescent reporter, or channel used to select the boundaries of the ROI.
GeoMxTissueStain.title: GeoMx Tissue Stain

NGSAlignedReads.description: Is a sequence that has been aligned to a gene/probe. Typically these reads can number from the hundreds of thousands to tens of millions. In GeoMx alignment is via mapping the RTS ID to a white list of sequences that represent targets.
NGSAlignedReads.title: NGS Aligned Reads

NGSDeduplicatedReads.description: Is the replacement of blocks of duplicate data with a Virtual Index Pointer linking the new sub-block to the existing block of data in a duplicate repository. This is used to reduce the amount of space need to store the data.
NGSDeduplicatedReads.title: NGS Deduplicated Reads

NGSRawReads.description: Reads not yet analyzed in any way to be used for data analysis. The number of reads that pass filter from the flow cell represented in the FASTQ file.
NGSRawReads.title: NGS Raw Reads

NGSSequencingCoverage.description: Depth of coverage on assembly used. Found by (Unique Aligned Basecalls)/(Reference Length)
NGSSequencingCoverage.title: NGS Sequencing Coverage

NGSStitchedReads.description: Represents consensus from the overlapping sequence of read 1 and 2. This is a % of the aligned reads that were overlapped and consensus confirmed, usually upward of 80% but less in terms of number of reads than aligned reads
NGSStitchedReads.title: NGS Stitched Reads

NGSTrimmedReads.description: Number of the reads remaining after trimming has been applied.
NGSTrimmedReads.title: NGS Trimmed Reads

NanoStringGeoMXROISegmentAnnotationId.description: Unique row identifier, used as a primary key for record updates
NanoStringGeoMXROISegmentAnnotationId.title: NanoStringGeoMXROISegmentAnnotation_id

title: NanoStringGeoMXROISegmentAnnotation
